Camera & Location Permission Needed

This app uses your camera and location to stamp the exact GPS address and a map onto your photos. No data is ever sent to a server — everything stays on your device.

On iPhone: open this page in Safari, tap the Share icon, then choose "Add to Home Screen".

Pro Settings

This logo gets embedded directly into the app file. Once you upload the regenerated file to GitHub, it shows on every device that opens the app — users can only turn it on/off from regular Settings, not change the image.

Manual100%

Add the location, address, time — and logo, if turned on — to photos already in your gallery, even ones not taken with this app. If a photo already has GPS info saved in it (most phone camera photos do), that location and date are read automatically; otherwise you'll be asked to enter one. Works with JPEG/PNG; HEIC photos (common on iPhone) usually can't be read by the browser — export them as JPEG first if needed.
